habitat: Open deciduous and mixed woodland with tall trees, riverine forest, orchards, parks and shelterbelts, often near water; 0–2000 m
description: Golden-yellow oriole with black wings and tail, male with black eyeline NOT extending behind the eye (the field mark separating it from Indian Golden Oriole), female greener with streaked underparts; summer visitor/passage migrant in open woodland and orchards; eats insects and fruit.
